query: What percentage of additional premium do individuals with serious pre-existing medical conditions need to pay for MediShield Life for the first 10 years?
context:
[Document 1]
Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.

[Document 2]
You can use MediSave to pay the premium for the additional private insurance coverage component up to the Additional Withdrawal Limits (AWLs).

[Document 3]
If you foresee difficulties in paying your future premiums using CPF, you may wish to consider the following options after consulting your insurance advisor:Pay the instalment using cash. Any proceeds from your insurance policy will then be apportioned according to the amount of premiums paid using cash and CPF;Change the payment frequency from yearly to half-yearly or even to quarterly or monthly, subject to the insurance company’s agreement, so that a lower premium will be deducted per payment;Reduce the sum assured, thus reducing the amount of premium payable; orConvert the policy to a paid-up policy.After you have decided on the option, you need to liaise with your insurance company on the payment of the premium.

[Document 4]
Members pay premiums ahead during their working ages under MediShield Life, and in return, they enjoy premium rebates during their older ages.

[Document 5]
The co-insurance for the first $5,000 claimable amount is $300, calculated as 10% of the remaining $3,000 beyond the $2,000 deductible.
answer: Based on Document 1, individuals with serious pre-existing medical conditions receive annual MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 from 2021 to 2025. However, the exact percentage increase in premium they need to pay for MediShield Life over time is not specified in the given evidence. [Document 1]
